title: A customer submits the RoleArn without an operator kernel
description:
## Found on `chatticus-b88c0a`

After `create-stack` there is no customer HTTP for `submit_self_setup_cross_account_role`. Operator HTTP is enable/suspend/reinstate only. The only `CrossAccountRoleInspector` is in-memory (Gherkin). The hand run used a labeled `/tmp` kernel script.

## Done when

A pending owner can submit their AWS account id and `ChatticusOrganizationComputerRole` ARN in-product. The live path inspects the role (ExternalId = `tenant_id`, required permissions) and on accept enables the org and writes AWS home. Behavior in Gherkin first. Do not `members seed`.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Plan reviewed and **authorized** with holes closed.

Worktree verified: `/tmp/chatticus-070cb4-submit-role` on `feat/070cb4-submit-role-arn` (HEAD `9065ecb`, not the primary clone; rebase onto `origin/develop` which has the pm authorize note).

**Closed on authorize:**
1. **One HTTP shape.** Success `200` with `accepted: true`. Inspect/validation failures `422` with the kernel `message`. Auth `403`. Do not use `200` + `accepted: false`.
2. **One kernel, two inspectors.** `InMemory` in Gherkin; `AwsCrossAccountRoleInspector` in production. Map STS/IAM into the existing snapshot/exception catalog so messages stay one family. Do not invent a second live-only message path.
3. **Kernel `actor_user_id` is required** (one path). Update existing kernel Gherkin steps. No dual signature.
4. **Do not edit `infra/customer-role.yml`.** ThinTurn Front Door `sts:AssumeRole` on `ChatticusOrganizationComputerRole` is in scope.
5. Wiki/runbook is `pm:` on `develop` after merge, not files in the product PR.

Tear the worktree down only after the manager closes the issue.

comments.text: PR [#326](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chatticus/pull/326) is up. Composer 2.5 product review in flight; merge after that plus green CI.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
PR [#326](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chatticus/pull/326) **request changes**. HTTP/owner/Gherkin shape is right; live inspector is not.

**Must fix (no `customer-role.yml` edit):**
1. After AssumeRole, do not call `iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy` — the published template does not grant it. Uncaught `AccessDenied` becomes HTTP 500, not 422. Inspect permissions with APIs the role already has (`GetRole`, `GetRolePolicy` / attached policies) and map `ClientError` into the kernel 422 catalog.
2. On AssumeRole failure, do not `GetRole` as the Anthus ThinTurn caller. That cannot read a customer role. Use assumed-role credentials after a successful assume, or drop the broken fallback and still 422 with a kernel message that tells them to re-run CFN with `OrganizationId={tenant_id}`.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR [#326](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chatticus/pull/326) still **request changes** after `94c14a9`. SimulatePrincipalPolicy and Anthus GetRole are gone. Remaining: `_granted_permissions_from_role_policies` still calls `iam:GetPolicy` / `iam:GetPolicyVersion` for attached managed policies. The published template is **inline only** and does not grant those actions. Drop the attached-policy loop; `ListRolePolicies` + `GetRolePolicy` is the inspect path.
